headline: List your vendors, tick what customer data each one holds, and get a ranked risk grid plus a ready-to-print breach-day checklist and draft customer note.

episode.title: AI Market Shocks, Anthropic’s Stock Slide, Gemini Releases, and Elon’s $435M Bet | #314

history.summary: A genuinely useful, self-contained tool that matches both the episode idea and the "Who-Holds-Our-List Desk" opportunity: live scoring, per-vendor checklists with concrete rotate actions and vendor questions, a clearly labeled example shop, an honest legal-advice disclaimer, and a clean print view that holds up on mobile. No canned output is presented as the user's real answer, there are no fabricated figures, and the code is a tidy, dependency-free vanilla JS build. The main gaps are polish items (no persistence across reloads, one misplaced "rotate" item) rather than anything that blocks shipping.
